items.text: Deploy gx-dep-30 shipped a new card-gateway build and card authorisations began failing, which surfaced as order-orchestrator errors. Reverting gx-dep-30 restored normal behaviour within minutes.

After gx-dep-39, recommender started cold and its latency climbed as all requests missed the cache together. The recompute load spilled onto catalog-service and storefront-bff. The on-call engineer flipped recommenderRail, which isolated recommender and stopped the damage.
Deploy gx-dep-47 reduced event-bus partition throughput and consumer lag grew steadily. The previous settings were restored and a follow-up issue was opened to tune event-bus capacity.

After gx-dep-58, fx-converter timed out on rate lookups and pricing returned errors. The order-orchestrator saga rejected foreign-currency baskets. Flipping the fxStaticRates flag contained the impact until a fixed build shipped.

Deploy gx-dep-63 changed cache keys in recommender; the cache emptied at once and every request recomputed (a stampede). The recompute load spilled onto catalog-service and storefront-bff. Reverting gx-dep-63 restored normal behaviour within minutes.
Deploy gx-dep-68 shipped a new card-gateway build and card authorisations began failing, which surfaced as order-orchestrator errors. Reverting gx-dep-68 restored normal behaviour within minutes.
A recommender release (gx-dep-81) invalidated its cache in one go and the stampede slowed recommender. The on-call engineer flipped recommenderRail, which isolated recommender and stopped the damage.
Deploy gx-dep-85 altered ledger-db settings; lock contention pushed ledger-service latency far above its band. A follow-up issue was opened against ledger-db once the config was restored.
After gx-dep-90, fx-converter timed out on rate lookups and pricing returned errors. Flipping the fxStaticRates flag contained the impact until a fixed build shipped.

Lock waits on ledger-db after gx-dep-92 made ledger-service slow to record postings. Callers such as card-gateway and invoice-service inherited the slowdown. The previous settings were restored and a follow-up issue was opened to tune ledger-db capacity.

Deploy gx-dep-99 altered legacy-cache settings; connection churn pushed the session-service error rate up. Requests through auth-service and storefront-bff failed authentication for a while. We rolled back gx-dep-99 and the metrics returned to baseline.

After gx-dep-103, legacy-cache evicted hot keys and session-service returned errors for returning users. Users of auth-service and storefront-bff were logged out. The on-call engineer flipped legacyCacheBypass, which isolated legacy-cache and stopped the damage.
After gx-dep-108, auth-service rejected valid tokens and the edge-gateway error rate climbed. Rolling auth-service back to the previous release cleared the problem.

After gx-dep-132, fx-converter timed out on rate lookups and pricing returned errors. The order-orchestrator saga rejected foreign-currency baskets. Rolling fx-converter back to the previous release cleared the problem.

A auth-service release (gx-dep-141) mis-handled key rotation and requests failed at edge-gateway. Signed-in users of storefront-bff and mobile-bff were bounced to login. We rolled back gx-dep-141 and the metrics returned to baseline.

Deploy gx-dep-142 changed rate caching in fx-converter and pricing failed to convert foreign-currency prices. Foreign-currency orders in order-orchestrator failed. Reverting gx-dep-142 restored normal behaviour within minutes.

Deploy gx-dep-150 shipped a pricing rule change to pricing and quotes started failing on storefront-bff. The mobile-bff app showed blank prices. We rolled back gx-dep-150 and the metrics returned to baseline.

A auth-service release (gx-dep-156) mis-handled key rotation and requests failed at edge-gateway. Both storefront-bff and mobile-bff saw authentication failures. Reverting gx-dep-156 restored normal behaviour within minutes.

Shortly after gx-dep-161 rolled out to card-gateway, order-orchestrator started failing orders at the payment step. A first attempt to flip deferredCapture did not take effect, so the team rolled back gx-dep-161 instead.

Lock waits on ledger-db after gx-dep-1024 made ledger-service slow to record postings. Both card-gateway and invoice-service timed out on ledger writes. Rolling ledger-db back to the previous release cleared the problem.

A pricing release (gx-dep-1035) broke rule evaluation and the storefront-bff error rate rose sharply. Shoppers on mobile-bff could not see prices. The on-call engineer flipped pricingRulesV2, which isolated pricing and stopped the damage.

Deploy gx-dep-1045 changed rate caching in fx-converter and pricing failed to convert foreign-currency prices. Foreign-currency orders in order-orchestrator failed. Rolling fx-converter back to the previous release cleared the problem.
